verifier_configs.name: deliverable_files_graded
verifier_configs.description: Open the files the agent wrote to /workspace and assert the audit's load-bearing figures and the required report content. Deterministic, no LLM.

metadata.how_justification: Checks metrics.json is present as a file in the workspace.
metadata.why_justification: The machine-readable summary is a required deliverable.

metadata.how_justification: Reads metrics.json and asserts cohort_size equals 116.
metadata.why_justification: Scoping the cohort is load-bearing: filtering on status instead of original_status, or ignoring account_type='joint', changes it.

metadata.how_justification: Reads metrics.json and asserts aged_out equals 50.
metadata.why_justification: Identifying the single backlog-closeout date and counting only its applications is the core finding.

metadata.how_justification: Reads metrics.json and asserts resolved_before_sweep equals 65.
metadata.why_justification: The merits-decided remainder must exclude both the sweep and the never-decisioned application.

metadata.how_justification: Reads metrics.json and asserts unresolved_person_kyc equals 68.
metadata.why_justification: Requires the person-level join; counting applications rather than applicant KYC records gets it wrong.

metadata.how_justification: Reads metrics.json and asserts both_applicants_unresolved equals 18.
metadata.why_justification: Separating both-applicants-stuck from one-applicant-stuck requires a per-application having clause.

metadata.how_justification: Reads metrics.json and asserts days_in_manual_review equals 309.
metadata.why_justification: The elapsed time for application 32855 proves the aging-out reading of its rejection.

metadata.how_justification: Checks report.md is present as a file in the workspace.
metadata.why_justification: The written brief is a required deliverable.

metadata.how_justification: Extracts report.md text and asserts it works the 32855 example.
metadata.why_justification: The brief must ground the finding in the specific application that triggered the escalation.

metadata.how_justification: Extracts report.md text and asserts the backlog-closeout date appears.
metadata.why_justification: The brief must name the date on which the aged-out applications were decided.

verifier_configs.name: method_cohort_and_person_join
verifier_configs.description: Trace shows the real method: pinned the cohort, found the closeout date from the decision-date distribution, and joined to applicant KYC.
verifier_configs.rubric: Examine the tool-call trace. PASS if the agent queried rds.account_applications for the pinned cohort (account_type joint, original_status manual_review, created in June 2024), determined the single bulk final-decision date empirically from the data (e.g. by grouping the cohort on the final decision date) rather than assuming it, AND joined rds.account_person_applications to rds.person_applications to inspect applicant-level kyc_status for the aged-out applications. FAIL if any of those three is missing, or if the figures were produced without querying the warehouse.

verifier_configs.name: aged_out_conclusion_stated
verifier_configs.description: Final answer states the aging-out conclusion with the 32855 walkthrough.
verifier_configs.rubric: Does report.md state a clear conclusion -- that application 32855 was not decided on its merits but was closed out in a single bulk backlog sweep of aged-out manual-review applications, with the cohort figures given -- and, for 32855 specifically, name its two linked person applications, state that their KYC never left manual_review (neither approved nor denied), and give the number of days it spent in manual review? PASS if the conclusion and the 32855 walkthrough are both present; FAIL if either is missing or the conclusion contradicts the finding.
